name: Y01 yamlRegionsOf: the pass is never kept
why: every ask makes its own pass again: a scan 2 passes (3 with the proof), scan plus attributeBlockReader 3 (4); killed by the count rows

name: Y02 yamlRegionsOf: the pass is kept with ||= for ??=
why: equivalent: the kept value is an array, which is never falsy, so ||= and ??= take the same branch for every document

name: Y03 yamlRegionsOf: the lines are joined with CRLF
why: quartoYamlRegions splits on a line feed with an optional carriage return, so the regions come out the same; killed only by the rows that read the text the pass was handed (the joined lines, byte for byte)

name: Y04 yamlRegionsOf: the first line is left out
why: every region is a line early: the metadata, the proof and the flags move; killed by the count rows and the differential

name: Y05 yamlRegionsOf: the pass is made eagerly, when the closure is made
why: a blank document (or a proof that is never reached) makes a pass it did not make; killed by the blank-document row and the asks row

name: Y06 yamlRegionsOf: the pass is of the empty text
why: no region is ever found; killed by the count rows (the text the pass was handed) and the mid-document answers

name: M01 readerMetadataOf: the default regions source is of no lines
why: asked without a source, no mid-document block is ever found; killed by the differential (every comparison calls readerMetadataOf(lines))

name: M02 readerMetadataOf: the KEY half is asked of the front matter only
why: a mid-document block that selects no longer selects; killed by the differential and the answer rows

name: M03 readerMetadataOf: the VALUE half is asked of the front matter only
why: a mid-document block's value is lost; killed by the differential and the answer rows

name: M04 readerMetadataOf: the KEY half finds the block again (the old duplication)
why: same answers, a second pass over the document; killed by the count rows alone (readerMetadataOf makes ONE pass, and asks the source it is handed once)

name: M05 frontMatterSelectsReader: any governing content selects
why: every document with a front matter or a block selects; killed by the differential and the answers

name: M06 frontMatterFromValueLine: the first line of the content is dropped
why: a `from:` on the first line of the block is lost; killed by the differential and the answers

name: G01 midDocumentMetadataBlocks: the regions are walked last first
why: the last SELECTING block governs, so the order is the answer once two blocks select differently; killed by the differential over seeded documents (the same mutant as R09 of s329-part5-pins-review)

name: G02 midDocumentMetadataBlocks: the shared list is reversed in place
why: the list the proof (and the next ask) reads is changed under them; killed by the frozen-list row (TypeError) and the differential

name: G03 governingMetadataContent: the walk is handed a source with no region
why: no mid-document block is ever found; killed by the differential and the answers

name: G04 governingMetadataContent: the walk makes a source of its own
why: the source it was handed is never asked; killed by the asks row and the empty-source row

name: P01 frontMatterProvesReader: the regions are made inline, as before
why: the same answers, a pass of its own on every document the proof reaches; killed by the count rows on the CommonMark documents and by the reach tally

name: C01 computeRegions: the shared source is of no lines
why: the scan finds no region: the metadata and the proof both read nothing; killed by the count rows (the text the pass was handed)

name: C02 computeRegions: the metadata read makes its own source
why: the proof then asks the scan's source and the read its own: two passes on a CommonMark document; killed by the count rows on those documents

name: C03 computeRegions: the proof makes its own source
why: two passes on every document the proof reaches; killed by the count rows on those documents

name: C04 computeRegions: the entry keeps no value
from: return { headings, cells, bodyLines, codeFenceOpeners, frontMatter, fromValueLine };
to: return { headings, cells, bodyLines, codeFenceOpeners, frontMatter, fromValueLine: null };
why: attributeBlockReader after a scan reads the default for every document; killed by the reader flags after a scan

name: C05 computeRegions: the entry keeps the value only where the key selects
from: return { headings, cells, bodyLines, codeFenceOpeners, frontMatter, fromValueLine };
to: return { headings, cells, bodyLines, codeFenceOpeners, frontMatter, fromValueLine: dialectOverride ? fromValueLine : null };
why: equivalent on every input tried, not proven: a resolved value implies the KEY half selects. A throwaway fuzz of contentFromValueLine against contentSelectsReader over 381,400 contents (every sequence of up to three of 43 YAML lines, nested, flow, alias and block-scalar spellings among them: 81,400; and 300,000 random contents of one to seven of them) found no content with a value and no key, and the differential's 69,905 + 3,468 + 6,000 documents find none either; a document that broke the implication would make this mutant killed by the reader flags after a scan

name: A01 attributeBlockReader: an entry is the text's by length
why: two cached texts of one length are taken for each other; killed by the one-length row

name: A02 attributeBlockReader: the newest entry is taken whatever its text
why: an unrelated scan's value is handed to a text; killed by the different-text rows

name: A03 attributeBlockReader: the entry is taken only when the text has none
why: inverted; killed by the counts and the answers

name: A04 attributeBlockReader: an entry's value is read as none
why: killed by the reader flags after a scan

name: A05 attributeBlockReader: a text with no entry reads as none
why: killed by the reader flags of a text never scanned and by the evicted-entry row

name: A06 attributeBlockReader: a text with no entry is scanned
why: the ask costs a whole scan for a caller that never scanned, and the scan is kept; killed by the row that scans the text after the ask and counts a pass

name: A07 attributeBlockReader: an entry that is read is promoted
to: const hitAt = regionsCache.findIndex((entry) => entry.text === text); if (hitAt > 0) regionsCache = promoted(regionsCache, hitAt); const scanned = hitAt >= 0 ? regionsCache[0] : undefined;
why: the replacement order moves when a value is read: the oldest entry is the wrong one; killed by the promotion row

name: A08 attributeBlockReader: the LAST entry of the text is taken
why: equivalent: every entry of one text holds the same value (the value is read from the lines of the text and nothing else), so the first and the last are the same value

name: A09 attributeBlockReader: only an engine-blind entry is taken
why: a scan under an engine is not served; killed by the any-key row

name: A10 attributeBlockReader: only an executing entry is taken
why: a knitr scan under no-execute is not served; killed by the any-key row

name: A11 unscannedFromValueLine: the front matter alone is read
why: a mid-document block's value is lost for a text never scanned; killed by the cold reader flags

name: A12 unscannedFromValueLine: the lines are split on a line feed alone
why: a carriage return stays on the end of each line of a CRLF text; killed by the terminator rows (see the why of the result)

name: A13 unscannedFromValueLine: the block is found through readerMetadataOf
why: equivalent in every answer (the KEY half is computed and dropped), one contentSelectsReader dearer; not a behaviour

name: T01 rows: the exhaustive documents are of up to 3 lines
why: killed by the floor on the number compared

name: T02 rows: 600 seeded documents
why: killed by the floors on the reach and the proof tallies

name: T03 oracle: a selecting block governs as itself even when it reads as nothing
why: the oracle then disagrees with the code under test on an empty `from:` below the first content line: the comparison is not vacuous

name: T04 oracle: a block inside an open comment is read
why: killed by the differential over documents with a comment open above a block

name: T05 oracle: an unterminated block is read
from: const content = end >= 0 ? body.slice(0, end) : region.terminated ? body : null;
to: const content = end >= 0 ? body.slice(0, end) : body;
why: killed by the differential over documents with an unterminated block

name: T06 oracle: a block holding a fence opener is read
why: killed by the differential over documents with a fence opener inside a block

name: T07 rows: the reach tally counts every document
why: every document then 'reaches' the regions, which is more than the documents with a value: killed by the upper bound on the reach

name: T08 rows: the proof compared with the inline regions is handed the shared source
why: the old side then reads no region and refuses every proof: the comparison against the proven documents disagrees
